facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of P-4104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4104, ACC-4104 and HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4104, ACC-4104 and HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4104, ACC-4104 and HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 1 October 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on P-4104, ACC-4104 and HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
